sections.h2: The green and black on your walls is alive
body: The dark streaks on shaded walls and the green film on stucco near the ground are algae and mildew. In Trenton, especially near Hart Springs and the Suwannee River corridor, trees and damp air keep them growing. Blasting them off with high pressure removes the color for a while but leaves the roots behind. Real pressure washing in Trenton FL relies on the right cleaning solution and enough dwell time to kill the growth, followed by a lower-pressure rinse that leaves the surface clean without harming it.
Too much pressure does real harm: it forces water behind paint, pulls out caulk, and scars soft stucco and wood. That damage often shows up only after the wall dries.

bullets: Siding and stucco: soft wash with detergent and dwell time
Decks and fences: gentle cleaning that does not raise the grain
Driveways and walks: higher pressure where concrete can handle it
Pollen and stains: targeted cleaning on porches and entries

body: Every exterior paint and stain job we do starts with washing, because primer cannot bond to mildew or chalk. If a repaint is coming within the year, ask us to quote both together; the wash is written into the prep and the surface goes straight into repairs once dry. See exterior painting in Trenton and Trenton deck staining for how that works.
As a standalone service, washing is usually scheduled quickly. We wet down and protect plantings before applying cleaners, and rinse landscaping again when we finish.

Once the surface is clean, a few habits slow the return of mildew: trimming shrubs back from walls, aiming sprinklers away from siding, and keeping gutters flowing so water does not sheet down one spot. If the paint underneath is chalky or failing, cleaning alone will not hold for long, and we will tell you so during the walkthrough. In that case, a repaint quoted with the wash is the better spend.
Visit the main pressure washing service page or the Trenton area page. For do-it-yourself background, read our guide to mold on siding and how to clean Florida pollen stains.

faqs.q: Will pressure washing damage my paint?
faqs.a: High pressure can. We use soft washing with detergent and dwell time on painted siding and stucco, saving higher pressure for concrete.

faqs.q: Do you wash roofs in Trenton?
faqs.a: Yes, with a low-pressure soft wash suited to the roofing surface.

faqs.q: Do you clean driveways and sidewalks too?
faqs.a: Yes. Concrete drives and walks can take higher pressure than siding, so they are cleaned separately from the house.

faqs.q: Do I need washing before you paint my house?
faqs.a: Washing is already part of our exterior prep, so it is included in your painting estimate rather than a separate call.
